name: atlas-obsidian
description: One Obsidian vault holds the wiki, the threads and chords, the sessions, and the changes of your work. Agents start in the vault, take a thread from stub to spec, tasks, and verification, and close it into the wiki. Twenty-two skills on five nouns (atlas, repo, wiki, thread, chord), four read-only agents, and hooks that keep the rules and a document for every session. Pairs with the atlas-obsidian binary, which serves the nine tools.
